title: A Reason for the Hope
key_points: Sanctify the Lord God in your heart first; a reasoned answer is born there, not in an opinion.
Be ready always, not only when convenient, because the question rarely comes at a good hour.
The hope itself must be visible in a believer's life before anyone will ask the reason for it.
Answer with meekness and fear, aiming to win the soul rather than merely win the argument.

verse.text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear.

scene.caption: Ready always, with meekness and fear
scene.alt: A lit lamp standing on a path at dawn beneath soft rays and a dove, hills in the distance.

title: The Evidence That God Exists
key_points: The universe had a beginning, and nothing has ever been observed to produce something from nothing.
Creation's design, from the cell's code to the ordered heavens, points to a Maker, leaving men without excuse.
A moral law written on every man's heart implies a Lawgiver higher than himself.
The evidence clears the ground for faith but does not save; only the Gospel has power to save.

verse.text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse.

scene.caption: The heavens declare the glory of God
scene.alt: A moon and scattered stars over dark hills, a lone tree standing beneath the night sky.

title: Why the Bible Can Be Trusted
key_points: Fulfilled prophecy, such as Micah naming Bethlehem centuries early, shows the Book is God-breathed.
The Scriptures have been preserved through persecution and confirmed by overwhelming manuscript evidence.
Sixty-six books by forty authors over sixteen centuries tell one unified story of one Redeemer.
Changed lives and the Book's honesty about its own heroes' failures testify it is not man's invention.

verse.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness.

scene.caption: Given by inspiration of God, and profitable
scene.alt: An open Bible resting on a podium with a scroll and a lit candle beside it, golden light above.

title: The Resurrection of the Lord Jesus Christ
key_points: The tomb was empty in the very city where He was crucified, and no enemy could produce the body.
Paul lists named, living witnesses, including above five hundred brethren, inviting investigation.
Frightened disciples who fled became fearless preachers, a change a stolen body cannot explain.
Every apostle sealed his testimony with his own death, and not one of them ever recanted.

verse.text: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee.

scene.caption: He is not here: for he is risen
scene.alt: An empty tomb standing open before a rising sun at dawn, mountains behind.

title: Answering the Common Objections
key_points: God is not the author of suffering; He entered our pain in the Lord Jesus Christ and promises overcoming.
God judges every man by the light given him, and every man has heard enough to be responsible.
Hypocrites in the church do not excuse anyone, for each man gives account of himself to God.
Science studies what God made; it answers how, while the Bible answers Who and why.

verse.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

scene.caption: An anchor holding fast through the storm
scene.alt: An anchor set firm above a stormy sea, distant thunder in a darkened sky.

title: Apologetics with Power
key_points: Paul's preaching stood not in the wisdom of men but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power.
Signs follow the preaching of the word; they do not lead it, and they must flow from holiness.
Boldness to speak and love for the soul must both accompany the power, or the power becomes noise.
A believer's own testimony of what God has done cannot be cross-examined away by any skeptic.

verse.text: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power.

scene.caption: Not in word only, but in power
scene.alt: A seven-branched lampstand burning brightly between two pillars in a hall, flame above.
